SCEN.what: Payer has no record of the claim for that patient and DOS.
causes: Sent to wrong payer ID or address
Patient ID mismatch so claim filed under another member

start: Verify patient name, DOB, member ID, DOS, billed amount
Ask rep to search by member ID and by DOS range, not only billed amount
flow.check: Is the claim still within timely filing?
yes: Ask claim mailing address / payer ID / fax for paper
Ask processing TAT for new claims
no: Check for proof of timely filing (999/277CA acceptance, prior EOB, payer letter)
If POTF exists: ask appeal address/limit and appeal with POTF
If no POTF: route for TFL write-off per client policy

exceptions: If rep finds claim under a different member ID → it is a patient-ID issue; correct and resubmit
If claim was rejected (not denied) at clearinghouse the TFL clock was never stopped—work rejections daily
Some payers accept electronic resubmission as POTF only with the 277CA payer acknowledgement, not the 999
SCEN.action: Pull clearinghouse reports before calling. Resubmit the same day if within TFL; set follow-up for 30 days.

SCEN.what: Claim received and pending adjudication.
causes: Pended for medical review, COB, or accident questionnaire

start: Ask why it is pending (review, COB, pricing, records)
flow.check: Is it beyond the payer's standard TAT (commonly 30 days electronic / 45 paper)?

exceptions: If pending for info from patient (COB/accident form) → call patient, it will deny if not answered
If pending for records → treat as 'medical records requested' scenario
Prompt-pay laws: many states require clean claims paid in 30–45 days with interest; note if exceeded
SCEN.action: Never resubmit a claim that is in process; it creates duplicate denials.

SCEN.t: Claim approved to pay (finalized, check not yet issued)
SCEN.what: Adjudicated as payable; payment in next cycle.

start: Get processed date, allowed, paid, patient responsibility
flow.check: Is a payment date or check run date available?
yes: Note expected payment date and method (EFT/check)

exceptions: If paid amount looks wrong vs contract, raise underpayment now before payment issues
SCEN.action: Follow up after payment date to confirm posting.

SCEN.what: Payment issued but not posted in the billing system.

start: Get paid date, allowed, paid, PR amounts, adjustment codes
flow.check: Was it paid by EFT?
yes: Get EFT trace #, date, bulk amount
Ask whether ERA was sent and to which clearinghouse
no: Get check #, date, bulk amount, address sent to

exceptions: Check not cashed > 90 days (some payers 180) → request stop-and-reissue
Check cashed but not received → request copy of cashed check (front/back) to find who deposited
Paid to wrong provider/TIN → request recoupment and reprocess
SCEN.action: Send details to payment posting; request EOB copy if missing.

SCEN.what: Payment withheld to recover an earlier overpayment on another claim.

start: Get paid amount and offset amount
Ask which claim (patient, DOS, ICN) the offset was applied to and why
flow.check: Is the original recoupment valid?
yes: Post payment and offset to the correct accounts
Rebill the correct payer if the recoupment was for COB/eligibility

exceptions: Negative balance appears on the original account until the offset is posted—do not refund twice
Medicare offsets come with a demand letter; respond within the letter's deadline to avoid interest
SCEN.action: Post both sides (payment + offset) so neither account shows a false balance.

SCEN.what: Payer sent payment to the member instead of the provider.
causes: No assignment of benefits on claim (box 13 / box 27)
Provider not set up for EFT/address

flow.check: Was assignment of benefits indicated and provider in network?
yes: Ask rep to void/recoup and reissue to provider
no: Bill patient for the amount paid to them
Note for future: fix AOB / signature on file

exceptions: Some BCBS plans pay members for OON services regardless of AOB—bill patient
If patient already cashed check, payer will not reissue
SCEN.action: Send patient statement with EOB copy; flag AOB form at front desk.

SCEN.what: Allowed amount went to patient deductible.

start: Confirm allowed amount and the deductible applied
Ask deductible total, met-to-date, plan year (calendar or plan)
Check that the service isn't preventive (ACA $0 cost-share)
flow.check: Is there a secondary/tertiary payer on file?
yes: Bill secondary with primary ERA/EOB (COB loop 2320)
If secondary is Medicaid/QMB: no patient billing
Track secondary TFL from primary paid date
no: Preventive code with deductible applied? Ask for reprocessing
Send statement; offer payment plan per policy

exceptions: Preventive services under ACA often waive deductible—if applied to a preventive code, ask for reprocessing
Medicaid secondary / QMB → patient cannot be billed
HSA/HDHP plans: deductible applies before almost everything except preventive
SCEN.action: Move to patient or secondary the same day.

SCEN.what: Provider is paid a per-member-per-month amount; fee-for-service claim pays $0.

start: Ask whether the provider/group is capitated for this member and service
flow.check: Is the provider under a capitation contract for this patient?
yes: Adjust as capitation per contract (not patient responsibility)

exceptions: Some services are carved out of capitation (labs, injections, procedures)—check the contract
Patient assigned to different PCP → may be 'not member's PCP' denial (CARC 242)

SCEN.what: Same service on same DOS was paid to another provider.
causes: Two providers billed the same global/technical service

start: Ask which provider/NPI was paid and the paid date
flow.check: Is the other provider part of our group/TIN?
yes: Ask for internal correction; post/transfer payment
no: Review coding: bill only the component we performed (26/TC)
Appeal with records if we performed the service
Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: Diagnostic tests in hospital setting: hospital gets TC; physician bills -26
SCEN.action: Send to coding for component review.

SCEN.t: Secondary cannot process without primary info (MA04 / CARC 22 / 23)
SCEN.what: Secondary payer needs the primary EOB or primary payment info.
causes: Primary EOB not attached / 2320 loop missing

start: Ask whether payer accepts electronic COB or paper EOB
flow.check: Has the primary processed the claim?
yes: Send claim with primary EOB/COB data

exceptions: Medicare crossover: if Medigap/Medicaid didn't receive crossover, bill them directly with Medicare MSN/ERA
If primary denied, secondary may still pay—send the denial EOB
SCEN.action: Include primary paid date, allowed, paid and CAS adjustments in the 837.

SCEN.t: Primary paid more than secondary allowed
SCEN.what: Primary payment exceeds the secondary's allowed amount, so secondary pays $0.

start: Compare primary paid vs secondary allowed
Check secondary COB method (standard / non-duplication / carve-out)
flow.check: Does secondary owe anything under its COB method?
yes: Request payment of the remaining amount with EOB
no: Medicaid/QMB secondary: write off; never bill the patient
Commercial: bill patient only for what the secondary EOB shows as PR

exceptions: Medicaid secondary: balance must be written off
Commercial secondary under 'carve-out' COB may leave patient balance

SCEN.what: Patient cost-share per plan design.

start: Read PR amounts by line (PR-1 deductible, PR-2 coinsurance, PR-3 copay)
Check whether copay was already collected at the visit
flow.check: Is there a secondary/tertiary payer?
yes: Apply copay collected; avoid double billing
no: Check the patient's OOP max; if met, ask payer to reprocess

exceptions: QMB patients: never bill Medicare cost-share to patient
Preventive services: cost-share should be $0 under ACA for in-network USPSTF A/B services
SCEN.action: Not appealable unless benefits were applied wrongly.

SCEN.t: Procedure code inconsistent with modifier / modifier missing
SCEN.what: Modifier billed doesn't fit the code, or a required modifier is missing.
causes: Wrong modifier (26 on a global-only code)
Payer policy doesn't accept that modifier

start: Ask which line and modifier, and what modifier the payer expects
Check patient payment history: has same CPT + modifier paid before?
flow.check: Did the same CPT with the same modifier pay previously?
yes: Ask rep to reprocess as payment received for same CPT & modifier
no: Ask appeal fax/address and appeal limit
Assign to coding for correct modifier → send corrected claim

exceptions: Assign to coding; once coding responds, send corrected claim if within corrected-claim limit
Anatomic modifiers (RT/LT/F1–F9/TA–T9) are a common miss
Medicare: 59 vs X{EPSU}—Medicare accepts both, some payers require X modifiers

SCEN.t: Procedure code / bill type inconsistent with place of service
SCEN.what: Code not payable at the POS billed.

start: Ask which POS is acceptable for this code
flow.check: Was the POS billed incorrectly per documentation?
yes: Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)
no: Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: Medicare telehealth 2026: POS 02 (other than home) / POS 10 (home); many commercial payers still want POS 11 + modifier 95
Hospital outpatient department: POS 19/22, not 11
SCEN.action: Verify POS against documentation, then correct.

SCEN.t: Procedure/revenue code inconsistent with patient's age
SCEN.what: Code is age-restricted.
causes: Pediatric/adult code mismatch (e.g. preventive visit age bands)

flow.check: Is the DOB in our system different from the payer's?
no: Send to coding for age-appropriate code
Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)

exceptions: Preventive E/M (99381–99397) are age-banded—most common cause

SCEN.t: Procedure/revenue code inconsistent with patient's gender
SCEN.what: Code restricted by sex.
causes: Transgender patient: sex on policy differs from anatomy

flow.check: Is demographic gender wrong?
no: For gender-specific care that matches anatomy, resubmit with condition code 45 (UB) or modifier KX (Medicare)
Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: Medicare: KX modifier indicates gender-specific service is appropriate
Institutional: condition code 45 'ambiguous gender category'

SCEN.t: Procedure code inconsistent with provider type/specialty
SCEN.what: Payer doesn't allow this specialty/taxonomy to bill the code.
causes: Mid-level billing a code restricted to physicians

start: Ask which specialty/taxonomy is on file
flow.check: Is the taxonomy/specialty on file wrong?
yes: Send to credentialing to update; ask for reprocessing after update
no: Rebill under eligible provider if documentation supports it
Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: Behavioral health: payer may not credential LMHC/LMFT—Medicare allows MFT/MHC since 2024
SCEN.action: Check NPPES taxonomy vs payer enrollment.

SCEN.what: Diagnosis code is age- or sex-specific.
causes: Wrong ICD-10 code (e.g. pregnancy code on male)

flow.check: Are demographics wrong?
no: Assign to coding for correct Dx
Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)

exceptions: Newborn codes (Z38, P-codes) only for newborn claims
Maternity codes O-chapter: age 12–55 edit
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: ICD-10 doesn't support the CPT under policy.
causes: Dx not on LCD/NCD covered list

start: Ask which Dx was considered and what policy applies
flow.check: Is a supporting Dx documented in the chart?
yes: Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)
no: Assign to coding with rep's statement
If no supporting Dx: write off or bill patient (only if ABN/waiver)

exceptions: Pointer errors are the #1 cause—check before coding review
Outpatient: Z-code can be moved out of primary if a symptom/condition is documented

SCEN.t: Date of death precedes date of service
SCEN.what: Payer shows patient deceased before DOS.

start: Ask date of death on file
flow.check: Is our DOS correct and before the date of death?
yes: Ask payer to correct date of death; request reprocessing / appeal with records
no: If DOS was wrong: corrected claim
If services after death (e.g. DME rental) → write off

exceptions: Services on the date of death are payable
Medicare: date of death comes from SSA—provider can appeal with records

SCEN.what: Generic denial; the RARC tells what's missing.

start: Ask exact remark code (e.g. MA130, N290, M51, N286)
flow.check: Can the missing information be added from our system?
yes: Correct and resubmit (Medicare MA130: as a new claim, not appeal)
no: Request info from provider/patient; set follow-up

exceptions: Medicare MA130 = unprocessable; no appeal rights—resubmit corrected
Never resubmit blind—fix the element in the RARC

SCEN.what: Same patient, DOS, provider, code already on file.

flow.check: Was the original claim paid?
no: If original denied: work that denial
If repeat service: corrected claim with 76/77/91 or units

exceptions: Same CPT paid on same DOS → denial correct; ask coding if a different CPT applies
Same DOS different provider → may be B20

SCEN.what: Payer says WC is primary.

flow.check: Is the injury work-related?
yes: Get WC carrier, claim #, adjuster, DOI from patient/employer
no: Ask patient to call payer and confirm not work-related
Ask payer for questionnaire / reprocessing after update

exceptions: If WC denies liability, send WC denial to health plan for payment
WC claims are not patient responsibility in most states while claim is open

SCEN.what: Third-party liability (e.g. premises) primary.

start: Get denial date and accident details on file (DOI, type)
Ask whether payer is waiting on an accident questionnaire
flow.check: Is there a liability carrier/attorney involved?
yes: Get carrier, claim #, adjuster; bill or place a lien per client policy
Hold the health claim until liability decides
no: Patient completes accident questionnaire stating no third-party liability

exceptions: Some clients place a lien with attorney instead of billing
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Auto PIP/MedPay primary.

start: Ask payer what auto info they have
flow.check: Has the auto/PIP carrier processed the claim?
yes: Bill health plan with the auto EOB showing PIP exhausted or denied
no: Get auto carrier, claim #, adjuster, PIP limits from patient
Bill auto carrier first; track auto TFL
If patient says not auto-related: questionnaire update and reprocess

exceptions: No-fault states (NY, FL, MI, NJ, PA etc.) require PIP first
Once PIP exhausted, health insurance pays

SCEN.t: Care may be covered by another payer (COB)
SCEN.what: Payer thinks another policy is primary.

start: Ask other insurance name, ID, effective dates on file
flow.check: Is the other payer actually primary per our records?
yes: Bill primary; send EOB to this payer
no: Ask patient to update COB with payer
Ask if claim reprocesses automatically after update

exceptions: Birthday rule for dependents
Medicare + employer group 20+ employees → group primary (aged); 100+ for disability
ESRD: group plan primary for 30-month coordination period
Medicaid is always payer of last resort

SCEN.t: Expenses before coverage / after coverage terminated
SCEN.what: DOS outside eligibility.
causes: Policy termed or not yet effective

flow.check: Does patient have another active plan for the DOS?
yes: Bill the correct payer (check its TFL)
no: If premium grace period (ACA 90-day): follow up after grace period ends

exceptions: Retro-termination after payment creates recoupment—bill new payer quickly
Marketplace plan in grace period month 2–3 pends then denies if unpaid

SCEN.what: Claim received after filing limit.

flow.check: Do we have proof of timely filing?
yes: Appeal with POTF (277CA, prior EOB from wrong payer, letters)
Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required
no: Adjust as TFL write-off (not patient responsibility)

exceptions: Medicare: 12 months from DOS; exceptions for retro-entitlement, admin error
Secondary TFL often counts from primary EOB date
Medicaid often 90–365 days; retro Medicaid gets extended limit

SCEN.t: Patient cannot be identified / name & ID mismatch
SCEN.what: Member not found.

start: Verify ID, name spelling, DOB with rep
flow.check: Does payer find the member with corrected data?
no: Call patient for current card; re-verify eligibility

exceptions: Medicare: use MBI (11 char) — HICN no longer accepted

SCEN.t: Charge exceeds fee schedule / contracted rate
SCEN.what: Contractual adjustment.

start: Compare allowed to contract fee schedule
flow.check: Does allowed match our contract?

exceptions: Medicare: compare with MPFS locality rate (non-facility vs facility)
Sequestration CO-253 2% is separate

SCEN.what: Plan excludes routine exam/screening.
causes: Routine exam billed with screening Dx on plan without preventive benefit

start: Confirm what Dx/CPT were billed (preventive vs problem codes)
flow.check: Was the visit problem-oriented (documentation has a chief complaint/management)?
yes: Coding: switch to problem E/M or add -25 problem visit
no: Medicare routine physical: patient liable (GY, no ABN needed)
Commercial: bill patient if plan excludes routine
Check if IPPE/AWV (Medicare) could have been billed instead

exceptions: Medicare covers IPPE (G0402) and AWV (G0438/G0439), not 99381–99397
Problem visit same day as preventive → 25 modifier
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Payer decided service unjustified.

start: Ask policy applied and what history was reviewed
flow.check: Does documentation support necessity / was ABN signed?
yes: Appeal with records & policy citation, or bill patient with GA
Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: Medicare: patient liable only with valid ABN (GA modifier)
Commercial in-network: patient usually not liable unless waiver signed

SCEN.what: Excluded under pre-ex clause.

flow.check: Is the plan ACA-compliant?
yes: Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: Pre-ex exclusions only legal on short-term, grandfathered individual, or excepted-benefit plans
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Payer deems service unproven.

flow.check: Was prior auth or a pre-service determination obtained?
yes: Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required
no: Appeal with peer-reviewed evidence or bill patient if waiver signed

exceptions: Category III (0xxxT) codes are commonly denied

SCEN.what: Service not payable at that POS.

flow.check: Is POS wrong per documentation?
yes: Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)
no: Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Not a covered benefit.

start: Read remark code; ask whether non-covered under patient's plan or provider contract
flow.check: Is it non-covered under the patient's plan?
no: If Dx issue, alternate Dx may make it covered → coding

exceptions: Medicaid: cannot bill patient
Telehealth not covered → patient responsibility unless state parity law
Ask if the patient is enrolled in the benefit vs service not offered

SCEN.what: No OON benefits (HMO/EPO).

start: Ask patient's plan type and whether OON benefits exist
flow.check: Is provider actually in network (contract/credentialing)?
yes: Ask payer to update network status and reprocess
no: Emergency? → No Surprises Act protections; appeal

exceptions: No Surprises Act: emergency services and certain non-emergency services at in-network facilities can't be balance billed
Gap exception/network adequacy appeal possible

SCEN.what: Payment included in another service.

start: Ask which code it bundled into
flow.check: Is the service distinct & documented?
yes: Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)

exceptions: NCCI modifier indicator 0 = never separable; 1 = separable with modifier
Global period: 0/10/90 days; use 24, 25, 57, 58, 78, 79

SCEN.what: Service in a surgery's global period.

start: Ask surgery CPT, surgery date, global days (0/10/90)
flow.check: Was the service unrelated, a complication needing OR, or a decision for surgery?
no: Routine post-op care: adjust as global

exceptions: 57 = decision for surgery (day before/day of major surgery)
24 = unrelated E/M in post-op

SCEN.what: Wrong payer/MAC.
causes: Medicare Advantage patient billed to Medicare

start: Ask payer which entity they show as responsible
flow.check: Is the patient enrolled in Medicare Advantage / another plan on DOS?
yes: Bill the MA plan or correct payer; never bill Medicare as secondary to MA
Check new payer's TFL; ask for exception if needed
no: Wrong MAC/jurisdiction or DME MAC: send to the correct contractor

exceptions: Hospice patients: related services billed to hospice
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Visit or dollar limit exhausted.

start: Ask the benefit limit, how many used, and which claims counted
flow.check: Did the payer count visits wrongly (denied visits, other provider, wrong year)?
no: Medicare therapy above KX threshold: corrected claim with KX if necessary
Ask about medical-necessity exception / additional visit request

exceptions: Medicare therapy: KX threshold—add KX when medically necessary above threshold

SCEN.what: Primary payer info on claim is wrong.

start: Ask what primary data on our claim conflicts (paid amount, date, CAS)
flow.check: Is our COB data wrong?
yes: Correct 2320/2430 loops from primary ERA and resubmit
no: If primary info changed (reprocessed), send updated EOB
Appeal if payer misread the EOB

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: ICD-10 deleted/not yet effective, or truncated.
causes: Code not billable to highest specificity

flow.check: Is the Dx code incomplete/expired?
yes: Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)

exceptions: ICD-10-CM updates Oct 1 each year (and April 1)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.t: Info doesn't support level of service
SCEN.what: Downcoded or denied level.

flow.check: Does documentation support level?
yes: Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: 2021+ office E/M: MDM or total time
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Exceeds allowed frequency.

start: Ask allowed frequency and date last paid
Check whether MUE or policy frequency
flow.check: Is additional frequency medically supported and documented?
yes: Appeal with records and LCD/policy criteria
Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: MUE: units above per-day limit deny; MAI 1 line edit, 2/3 date edits

SCEN.what: Records requested.

start: Ask exactly which documents, where to send (fax/portal), deadline
flow.check: Were records already sent?
yes: Give fax confirmation/date; ask payer to locate and reprocess
no: Send with cover sheet listing claim #, member ID, DOS

exceptions: Use PWK segment / attachment control # on future claims

SCEN.t: Procedure code / modifier invalid on DOS
SCEN.what: Code deleted or not yet valid.

flow.check: Was code invalid on DOS?
yes: Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Provider not enrolled to order/refer or render.

start: Ask which NPI (rendering vs referring/ordering) and which loop/box
flow.check: Is that provider enrolled & active on DOS (NPPES, PECOS, payer)?
yes: Data error: corrected claim with right NPI/name
no: Ordering/referring not in PECOS: provider must enroll; rebill after
Rendering not credentialed: credentialing team; hold claims

exceptions: Medicare: ordering/referring for DME, labs, imaging must be in PECOS

SCEN.what: No prior auth.

start: Ask whether this CPT requires auth; request list of auth-required codes
flow.check: Do we have a valid auth for DOS?
no: Ask if retro-auth allowed and steps

exceptions: In-network: provider cannot bill patient for missing auth
DOS outside auth: ask if it's no coverage or no auth

SCEN.t: Revenue code and procedure code mismatch
SCEN.what: UB-04 rev code doesn't match HCPCS.

flow.check: Rev code wrong?
yes: Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.t: Information requested from provider / patient not provided
SCEN.what: Payer asked for info and got none.

start: Ask what information was requested and from whom, and the request date
flow.check: Is the information needed from the patient?
yes: Call the patient to respond to payer (COB, accident, other insurance)
Ask payer to reprocess once received

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.t: Not paid separately / NCCI combination incompatible
SCEN.what: Procedure not separately payable.

flow.check: Is a modifier appropriate?
yes: Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Patient's assigned PCP differs.

start: Ask member's assigned PCP and plan type
flow.check: Is the rendering provider the assigned PCP or is a referral on file?
no: Member changes PCP with payer (often retro to 1st of month)
HMO without referral: patient responsibility only if state/contract allow—confirm client

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: HMO/POS referral missing.

start: Ask rep: referral on file? Hospital claim with referral same DOS?
flow.check: Is a referral found (our system, payer, hospital claim)?
no: HMO/POS none found: appeal or write off
Ask appeal fax # / mailing address / portal
Ask if records or a form are required

exceptions: Referral # location: CMS-1500 box 23 (referring provider box 17)
Referral visits exhausted → treat as no referral
Don't call PCP unless client allows

SCEN.what: Credentialing not effective.

start: Ask provider's effective date and status on file
flow.check: Is credentialing effective for DOS (including retro)?
no: Send to credentialing; request retro effective date
If no retro: write off per client policy (not patient)

exceptions: Medicare allows retro billing 30 days before enrollment application date
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Service related to terminal illness.

start: Ask hospice name, election date, terminal diagnosis
flow.check: Is the service unrelated to the terminal condition?
yes: Attending not employed by hospice: GV
no: Bill the hospice agency per arrangement

exceptions: GV = attending physician not employed by hospice
GW = unrelated to terminal condition
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: NDC missing or invalid.

flow.check: Is a valid 11-digit NDC available?
yes: Corrected claim: N4 qualifier + NDC (5-4-2) + unit qualifier (UN/ML/GR/F2) + quantity
no: Check NDC active on DOS (FDA NDC directory)

exceptions: Convert 10-digit to 5-4-2 with leading zero
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Lab test without valid CLIA.
causes: CLIA missing in box 23/2300 REF X4

start: Check lab test complexity vs CLIA certificate type
flow.check: Is the CLIA cert valid and appropriate for the test?
yes: Corrected claim with CLIA in box 23 / REF X4; QW for waived tests
no: Certificate lapsed or wrong level: write off; route to compliance

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: Patient seen by same specialty/group within 3 years.

start: Ask prior visit date and provider
flow.check: Was the patient seen by same specialty/group in last 3 years?
yes: Send corrected claim (freq. code 7 + original ICN)

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: 2% Medicare payment reduction.

flow.check: Is the reduction exactly sequestration?
yes: Post as contractual; not patient responsibility

exceptions: Check the client's rules before billing the patient for any CO denial—CO means provider liability
If the same denial hits many claims, treat it as a bulk issue (see Bulk issues)
ask: Is this denial appealable or corrected-claim only?

SCEN.what: An auth exists but the number on the claim is wrong or doesn't cover the code/units/dates.
